a.lede: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
a.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027

b.lede: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only four people booked a ride using an AI agent.
b.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
